notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla's self-mover wire: the MSG_MOVE_* stream, spline-done ack, worldport ack, teleport ack (full guid), the four forced-speed-change acks, and the granted move-mode ack family (root/unroot/water-walk/feather-fall/hover). MSUI implements the MSG_MOVE_* transition stream with correct MovementInfo tails (LocalMovementSender + MovementInfo.Write), MSG_MOVE_TELEPORT_ACK receive+full-guid reply, CMSG_MOVE_WORLDPORT_ACK, and the root/unroot ack pair, but none of the speed-change or remaining mode acks and no spline-done.
